summary_md: **恒星sun ([@vintcessun](https://x.com/vintcessun/status/2116733484316369047))** breaks down NVIDIA's *Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning* report ([arXiv 2610.38095](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.38095)): Super is 120B/12B active and Lightning 30B/3B, both hybrid Mamba-Transformer MoE; Super reports 51.78% on SWE-bench Pro and parallel agents with self-verification lift Terminal-Bench 2.1 from 62.7% to 71.9%, though he cautions real value depends on hardware and load.

referenced_urls.title: Nemotron 3.5 Super and Lightning: Open, Efficient...

relevance: Both target model sizes for DGX Spark.

media.description: Bar charts comparing Nemotron 3.5 Super/Ultra against Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM and other open models across agentic, coding, math and long-context benchmarks, plus a GB200 max-throughput chart showing roughly 2.3x for Nemotron 3.5 Super.
Table 3 of a Lightning 3.5 report: research ablations with 10/20/30% Indic data shares raising the four-benchmark mean from 45.5 to 63.1/64.6/65.6.
media.ocr_text:
Table 3 : Lightning 3.5 research ablations. Each ablation uses a 200B-token budget. The reported mean
covers MILU, MMLU-Pro, ARC-Challenge, and GSM8K. The base checkpoint is shown for reference; the
fixed-budget comparison covers the three ablation runs.
Checkpoint Indic share Four-benchmark mean
Base reference 45.5
Mixture ablation 10% 63.1
Mixture ablation 20% 64.6
Mixture ablation 30% 65.6
